mapper.select: SELECT pr.id, pr.payment_no AS paymentNo, pr.direction, pr.biz_type AS bizType, pr.party_type AS partyType, pr.party_id AS partyId, pr.amount, pr.currency, pr.exchange_rate AS exchangeRate, pr.amount_cny AS amountCny, pr.paid_at AS paidAt, pr.method, pr.ref_type AS refType, pr.ref_id AS refId, pr.status, pr.remark, pr.created_by AS createdBy, pr.created_at AS createdAt, pr.updated_at AS updatedAt, CASE pr.party_type WHEN 'SUPPLIER' THEN s.name WHEN 'PLATFORM' THEN sh.shop_name END AS partyName FROM payment_record pr LEFT JOIN supplier s ON pr.party_type = 'SUPPLIER' AND pr.party_id = s.id LEFT JOIN shop sh ON pr.party_type = 'PLATFORM' AND pr.party_id = sh.id WHERE pr.deleted = 0 AND pr.direction = #{direction} AND pr.biz_type = #{bizType} AND pr.party_type = #{partyType} AND pr.party_id = #{partyId} AND pr.paid_at >= #{paidFrom} AND pr.paid_at <= #{paidTo} AND pr.status = 'NORMAL' ORDER BY pr.paid_at DESC, pr.id DESC

SELECT t.supplierId, t.supplierName, t.settleDays, t.payableAmount, t.paidAmount, t.payableAmount - t.paidAmount AS unpaidAmount FROM ( SELECT s.id AS supplierId, s.name AS supplierName, s.settle_days AS settleDays, (SELECT COALESCE(SUM(po.total_amount), 0) FROM purchase_order po WHERE po.supplier_id = s.id AND po.status <> 'DRAFT') AS payableAmount, (SELECT COALESCE(SUM(a.amount), 0) FROM payment_alloc a JOIN payment_record pr ON a.payment_id = pr.id JOIN purchase_order po2 ON a.alloc_biz_id = po2.id WHERE a.alloc_biz_type = 'PURCHASE' AND pr.status = 'NORMAL' AND pr.deleted = 0 AND po2.supplier_id = s.id) AS paidAmount FROM supplier s WHERE s.deleted = 0 ) t WHERE t.payableAmount > 0 OR t.paidAmount > 0 ORDER BY t.supplierId DESC

SELECT pr.party_id AS shopId, sh.shop_name AS shopName, COUNT(*) AS receiptCount, COALESCE(SUM(pr.amount), 0) AS amount, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN pr.amount_cny IS NOT NULL THEN pr.amount_cny ELSE 0 END), 0) AS amountCny, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN pr.amount_cny IS NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0) AS missingRateCount FROM payment_record pr LEFT JOIN shop sh ON pr.party_id = sh.id WHERE pr.deleted = 0 AND pr.status = 'NORMAL' AND pr.direction = 'INCOME' AND pr.party_type = 'PLATFORM' AND pr.paid_at >= #{paidFrom} AND pr.paid_at <= #{paidTo} GROUP BY pr.party_id, sh.shop_name ORDER BY amountCny DESC, shopId DESC

SELECT COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN direction = 'INCOME' AND amount_cny IS NOT NULL THEN amount_cny ELSE 0 END), 0) AS incomeCny, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN direction = 'EXPENSE' AND amount_cny IS NOT NULL THEN amount_cny ELSE 0 END), 0) AS expenseCny, COUNT(*) AS totalCount, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN amount_cny IS NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0) AS missingRateCount FROM payment_record WHERE deleted = 0 AND status = 'NORMAL' AND paid_at >= #{paidFrom} AND paid_at <= #{paidTo}
